schemaNote: Reusable regional country-directory data model for GPIR, following the same shape as assets/data/apac-countries.json. 'status' drives whether a directory entry is clickable: active = a real, published Country Intelligence page exists; building = the page exists but intelligence is still being developed; coming_soon = the country is on the GPIR roadmap but no page is published yet. All 21 LATAM countries are coming_soon in this release — no country page has been built yet, so none are marked active or building. Mexico was added in the GPIR Americas Regional & Country Intelligence sprint: LATAM remains Mexico's sole canonical intelligence record, and the Americas region index (assets/data/americas-countries.json) cross-links to this record rather than duplicating it. Each entry also documents (without fabricating values) the fuller record shape GPIR intends once a country is researched: diasporaData, p2pData, corridorData, fintechData, paymentInfrastructure, regulatoryData, commentary and sources, each populated only when a real, cited source exists.
